summary: Our project illustrates the machineries and instruments used by NASA to explore the ever-unknown space. Our mission is to create a legacy for these machines so that humanity may never forget what they have achieved. Because of our project, it could possibly bring us greater opportunities to learn more about space and its history by replicating and improving the technology that was used in these older machines. Our project will illustrate the technology and achievements accomplished by these machines so that the future remembers the machines and what they have done.
details: Our project's mission is to make people remember the achievements and accomplishments that the machineries and instruments that were once active made. It was made so that the machineries would have their own legacy. We used HTML, CSS and JS for the project. We believe that the project stands out from others by being interactive and having live 3D models.
dataRefs: NASA – Human Artifacts on the Moon
